parameters.toolDescription: Read a specific HTML page from the Multi Project Tracker running on localhost:8080. Available pages: default.html, projects.html, ai-learning.html, Week1_Learning_Summary.html, Week2_Learning_Summary.html, Week3_Learning_Summary.html, Week4_Learning_Summary.html, architecture-diagram.html
parameters.url: =http://localhost:8080/{{ $fromAI('page_name', 'The HTML filename to fetch e.g. Week4_Learning_Summary.html', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Read the Project Status Tracker page which contains live status of ALL projects — red zone, at-risk, overdue, completed and active. Use this for ANY question about project status, health, or which projects need attention. No input needed.
Returns the list of all available HTML pages in the Multi Project Tracker with a description of each. Use this when the user asks what pages are available or which week covers a topic.
parameters.jsCode:
return [{ json: { pages: [
  { page: 'default.html', description: 'Landing dashboard' },
  { page: 'projects.html', description: 'All projects summary' },
  { page: 'ai-learning.html', description: 'AI Learning hub — 6 week cards' },
  { page: 'Week1_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 1 — Prompt Engineering and LLM Basics' },
  { page: 'Week2_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 2 — RAG and Vector Databases' },
  { page: 'Week3_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 3 — AI Agents and Tool Use' },
  { page: 'Week4_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 4 — Multi-Agent Systems, OpenAPI, MCP' },
  { page: 'architecture-diagram.html', description: 'System architecture diagram' },
  { page: 'Project_StatusTracker.html', description: 'Live project status — red zone and overdue data' }
]}}]
